title: Rory and the Silver Moon Cove
verses:
The stars started blinking above the lagoon,
When Nia flew down through the cool evening breeze.
She called out to Rory beneath the soft moon,
To show him a path through the tall whispering trees.

Then Ricky ran forward with hops full of grace,
While Psittaco nestled on Tilly's warm side.
Soft moss made a path to a quiet blue place,
Where Benny walked slow down the sleepy divide.

The water was glowing with bubbles of white,
And blossoms were closing their petals to rest.
Big shadows grew still in the shimmering night,
As birds drifted home to a comfortable nest.

Then Benny lay down on the bank near the stream,
While Rory curled up in a hammock of reed.
The air was as soft as a magical dream,
With all of the rest that the dinosaurs need.

Now Psittaco yawned in the curve of a wing,
As Ricky found shelter beneath a high ledge.
Soft ripples had ceased their low murmur to sing,
And sleepiness gathered around the lake edge.

Deep darkness spread over the cove far and wide,
Where Rory was drifting in dreams of his own.
With Tilly and Benny asleep by his side,
The gentlest of nights in the jungle was known.
